title: Component Interaction & Behavior Patterns
scope: General product-independent UI/UX, with navigation, manipulation, alternative views and iconography.

patterns.name: Persistent Sidebar Navigation
patterns.behavior: Keep primary destinations reachable while working; collapse when space is scarce.
patterns.acceptance: Navigate without losing work; test compact/mobile presentation.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesis; product examples establish existence, not universal adoption or effectiveness.

patterns.name: Collapsible Sections
patterns.behavior: Expand or collapse secondary groups; preserve essential paths and expose expanded state.
patterns.acceptance: Keyboard/touch toggle, meaningful accessible name and state; reopening restores group.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesis; product examples establish existence, not universal adoption or effectiveness.

patterns.name: Pinned Items
patterns.behavior: Keep selected references prominent independently of recency; pinning is not moving the underlying object.
patterns.acceptance: Pin and unpin without duplication or deletion; reload preserves intended preference.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesis; product examples establish existence, not universal adoption or effectiveness.

patterns.name: Favorites
patterns.behavior: Provide user-controlled quick access to frequently used objects; distinguish favorite from pin if both exist.
patterns.acceptance: Toggle favorite from accessible control; reflect same status in other views.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesis; product examples establish existence, not universal adoption or effectiveness.

patterns.name: Custom Sections
patterns.behavior: Let people create, rename, order and remove navigation groups where workflows differ.
patterns.acceptance: Create section, move links, remove section with clear consequences; do not delete underlying objects inadvertently.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesis; product examples establish existence, not universal adoption or effectiveness.

patterns.name: Nested Navigation
patterns.behavior: Use hierarchy for real parent-child organization or explicitly labeled shortcut grouping.
patterns.acceptance: Expand/collapse with keyboard and touch; avoid cycles and unbounded depth.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesis; product examples establish existence, not universal adoption or effectiveness.

patterns.name: Workspace Switcher
patterns.behavior: Switch workspace scope with visible active context; preserve authorized state per workspace.
patterns.acceptance: Switch A/B; check no stale or unauthorized content; restore prior view where supported.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesis; product examples establish existence, not universal adoption or effectiveness.

patterns.name: Recently Visited Items
patterns.behavior: Offer recent destinations as dynamic shortcuts without implying stable pin order.
patterns.acceptance: Recent items reflect visits and permissions; provide clear empty state.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesis; product examples establish existence, not universal adoption or effectiveness.

patterns.name: Navigation Personalization
patterns.behavior: Permit reordering or hiding secondary destinations; preserve a recoverable default.
patterns.acceptance: Hide and restore navigation; refresh and verify preference scope.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesis; product examples establish existence, not universal adoption or effectiveness.

patterns.name: Navigation Badges
patterns.behavior: Use meaningful counts or status markers, not ornamental noise.
patterns.acceptance: Status is readable without color alone and reflects actual count semantics.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesis; product examples establish existence, not universal adoption or effectiveness.

patterns.name: Overflow Navigation
patterns.behavior: Keep frequent actions discoverable and group less-used actions in a labeled overflow.
patterns.acceptance: Keyboard/touch can access hidden items; active destination remains apparent.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesis; product examples establish existence, not universal adoption or effectiveness.

patterns.name: Resizable / Collapsible Sidebar and Sidebar Peek
patterns.behavior: Offer size adjustment or temporary reveal when useful; separate peek from persistent open state.
patterns.acceptance: Test min/max size, keyboard/touch alternative, focus, and no inadvertent overlay.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesis; product examples establish existence, not universal adoption or effectiveness.

patterns.name: Drag-and-Drop Reordering
patterns.behavior: Reorder within a collection; make target, drag state, insertion and result clear.
patterns.acceptance: Drag and non-drag pointer alternative; keyboard reorder; persist order and handle failures.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesis; product examples establish existence, not universal adoption or effectiveness.

patterns.name: Move Between Groups
patterns.behavior: Move reference or underlying object with clear destination and consequences; distinguish copy, move, pin and grouping.
patterns.acceptance: Move via menu or drag; validate permissions and consequences; preserve identity.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesis; product examples establish existence, not universal adoption or effectiveness.

patterns.name: Inline Creation
patterns.behavior: Create in current context without unnecessary navigation; make default destination visible.
patterns.acceptance: Create in correct group; allow cancel; invalid data remains recoverable.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesis; product examples establish existence, not universal adoption or effectiveness.

patterns.name: Inline Renaming
patterns.behavior: Edit simple name near object; explicit save/cancel semantics.
patterns.acceptance: Rename via keyboard/touch, cancel restores old title, error retains edit.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesis; product examples establish existence, not universal adoption or effectiveness.

patterns.name: Contextual Tools
patterns.behavior: Keep secondary commands close to object; visible essential actions and accessible alternative to hover/right-click.
patterns.acceptance: Focus and touch reveal same relevant actions; no accidental selection or focus loss.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesis; product examples establish existence, not universal adoption or effectiveness.

patterns.name: Multi-selection and Bulk Actions
patterns.behavior: Select multiple items with clear selection scope and applicable actions.
patterns.acceptance: Count selected, select/clear range, bulk failure reports partial outcomes; keyboard and touch supported.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesis; product examples establish existence, not universal adoption or effectiveness.

patterns.name: Direct Manipulation
patterns.behavior: Manipulate visible objects with immediate feedback and reversible edits where practical.
patterns.acceptance: Input targets and feedback remain clear; cancel drag; offer pointer and keyboard alternatives.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesis; product examples establish existence, not universal adoption or effectiveness.

patterns.name: Alternative Views
patterns.aliases: View Switching; View Toggle; Multiple Views
patterns.behavior: Present same underlying objects in task-appropriate list, table, card/grid, board, calendar or timeline views; view toggle changes presentation, not object identity.
patterns.acceptance: Switch layouts, preserve shared filters/selection where meaningful; clarify per-view settings and no data duplication.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesis; product examples establish existence, not universal adoption or effectiveness.

patterns.name: Saved Views
patterns.aliases: Custom Views; named views; saved search
patterns.behavior: Persist a named query/layout configuration independent of underlying data; define personal/shared scope.
patterns.acceptance: Save, rename and reopen a filtered view; permissions and changes remain explicit.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesis; product examples establish existence, not universal adoption or effectiveness.

patterns.name: Sorting, Filtering and Grouping
patterns.behavior: Allow task-relevant query refinement; visible active criteria, reset and clear results.
patterns.acceptance: Combine filters, change sort/group, clear; distinguish zero matches from loading/error.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesis; product examples establish existence, not universal adoption or effectiveness.

patterns.name: Display Options
patterns.behavior: Configure visible fields and layout density as appropriate without changing data or access.
patterns.acceptance: Hide/show field, restore defaults; personal/shared scope and accessibility preserved.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesis; product examples establish existence, not universal adoption or effectiveness.

patterns.name: Swimlanes and Sub-grouping
patterns.behavior: Use a second grouping dimension only when it improves understanding of work.
patterns.acceptance: Group and regroup same records; keep accessible navigation across lanes and avoid lost items.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesis; product examples establish existence, not universal adoption or effectiveness.

patterns.name: Persistent View State
patterns.behavior: Persist chosen layout, sorting, grouping and filters at the intended user/view scope.
patterns.acceptance: Reload, return from detail and switch devices if supported; do not overwrite shared defaults silently.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesis; product examples establish existence, not universal adoption or effectiveness.

patterns.name: Customizable Dashboard Layout
patterns.behavior: Arrange different views of shared data for a task; widgets retain permissions and meaningful filters.
patterns.acceptance: Change layout and inspect each widget; view configuration does not bypass underlying access.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesis; product examples establish existence, not universal adoption or effectiveness.

patterns.name: Semantic Iconography
patterns.behavior: Use consistent understandable symbols for actions and destinations; label ambiguous icons.
patterns.acceptance: Compare icon stroke, size and meaning; accessible names and visible text for ambiguous actions.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesis; product examples establish existence, not universal adoption or effectiveness.

patterns.name: Monochromatic Outline Iconography
patterns.behavior: Use restrained coherent visual language where it improves clarity; outline style is a choice, not standard.
patterns.acceptance: Contrast and active state clear; no inference of specific icon library from appearance.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesis; product examples establish existence, not universal adoption or effectiveness.

patterns.name: Consistency and Standards
patterns.behavior: Reuse learned conventions unless evidence justifies a departure; consistency is not identical visuals.
patterns.acceptance: Same action has same meaning, labels, and behavior; validate unfamiliar symbols with users.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesis; product examples establish existence, not universal adoption or effectiveness.

component_matrix: Alternative Views; sorting/filtering/grouping; multi-selection; bulk actions
Column resizing/reordering; inline edit; frozen columns; sorting/filtering; selection
Pin/favorite; sections; move/reorder; contextual tools; peek; width
Pin; reorder; duplicate; split view; state preservation
Autosave; undo/redo; version history; inline formatting
Inline validation; conditional fields; draft persistence
caveats: Component Interaction & Behavior Patterns is a proposed internal catalog name; established umbrella is Interaction Design Patterns / Application Design Patterns / HCI Design Patterns.

Workspace Customization, Navigation Interaction Patterns, Direct Manipulation, Alternative Views, Saved Views and Display Options are useful research terms. Alternative Views is historical; the 2026 date is review date, not invention date.

A component is a UI structure; a pattern solves a recurring interaction problem; a capability is a specific behavior. Do not mandate all capabilities on every component. Separate UI presentation, domain data, permissions, and personal/shared view configuration.

Capacities sections are shortcuts, not necessarily folders; moving a ChatGPT chat into a project may change project context. Antigravity documented conversation commands do not establish identical web-sidebar affordances; Claude features vary with rollout. No authenticated DOM inspection or icon-library identification.

WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.7 requires a non-drag single-pointer alternative where applicable, with stated exceptions; keyboard accessibility is separate. Do not rely on hover or drag alone. Validate focus, touch, status announcements, error recovery, and permissions.

The component matrix is a discovery checklist, not independently researched prescriptions for every component. Cross-index existing patterns instead of treating all entries as net-new. Prior links not revalidated are labeled.
